claim_text: Our Total Recordable Injury Frequency Rate of 1.87 represents an improvement on the prior year; however, it remains above the levels we expect of ourselves.
label: Fully Supported
rationale_short: The safety performance table shows Group TRIFR improved from 2.11 in 2024 to 1.87 in 2025.
llm_reason: The claim’s decisive assertion is that the Total Recordable Injury Frequency Rate (TRIFR) is 1.87 and that this is an improvement on the prior year. The provided evidence shows Group TRIFR of 2.11 in 2024 and 1.87 in 2025, which directly verifies both the stated TRIFR value (1.87) and the year-over-year improvement (a decrease from 2.11 to 1.87). The additional statement that it “remains above the levels we expect of ourselves” is subjective and not numerically defined, but it does not conflict with the evidence and is not required to validate the factual improvement claim.
